inputs.text: Local organizers in southern Alberta are gathering signatures for the Water Not Coal petition that Corb Lund launched last month. This citizen initiative is calling on the Government of Alberta to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration.” This is being spun as a necessary grassroots effort to challenge big business, but it really represents an attempt by progressive forces to impose restrictions that would damage Alberta's traditional industries. These industries have provided stable employment and supported family values through generations of hard work and resource stewardship. Instead of allowing such petitions to dictate policy, we should uphold the authority of the provincial government to pursue balanced development that strengthens our nation and prioritizes the well-being of ordinary citizens over radical environmental demands.

output.main_topic: Water Not Coal petition opposing coal exploration and the debate over its impact on Alberta's industries
